The building is positioned on terrain with a pronounced slope, which directly influenced its form and functional organization. The architectural design is inspired by local vernacular architecture, with a facade clad in wooden slats and decorative meshes, which give the building a natural and authentic character.
The complex would comprise 268 apartment units — including studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments — as well as a restaurant with a kitchen, bar, and terrace, a spa zone, and a pool atrium with carefully landscaped ground-level areas, cascading retaining walls and planters.
